_note: brindle_guard 的填充。與 brown_mixed 五條特徵全部相反（見 specs/characters/brindle_guard.json 的 three_channel_identity）。虎斑那條特別長，因為那是 64px 上最容易畫壞的東西——實照的細密紋路降採樣後只會變成雜訊。　背帶那條改寫過一次：原本寫「solid flat block」不夠強，模型仍然畫成繞腹的細帶子，降到 64px 之後變成沿著前腿到腳掌的粉紅線——畫面上是狗穿粉襪。所以改成明確禁止「thin straps」「繞腹」「碰到腿或腳掌」。
SUBJECT: the exact same golden-brindle mixed-breed guard dog shown in the attached reference image. Same build, same head size, same markings, same colors, same art style. Do not redesign it, do not make it cuter or younger or smaller.
IDENTITY:
- Golden tan / wheaten base coat as the main body color
- BRINDLE STRIPES, drawn as only 3 to 5 THICK dark vertical bars on the flank, each bar a solid block two pixels wide with a clear gap between them, plus 2 more bars on the rear thigh. Treat it like big-cat stripes: FEW and BOLD. Do NOT draw fine, thin, numerous or hair-like stripes.
- A near-black saddle covering the back and the shoulders, running from the base of the neck to the loin, clearly darker than the flank
- Large pointed triangular ears, fully erect and standing straight up, set high on the head. The ears must NOT hang down.
- A dark mask around the muzzle and lower jaw, clearly darker than the cheeks and forehead
- A small amount of pale grey grizzle right at the lips, much smaller than a full muzzle patch
- Black nose, NOT liver brown
- PALE BLUE-GREY eyes with a single white highlight. The irises are light blue, NOT amber, NOT brown, NOT yellow.
- A PALE PINK / SALMON chest harness, drawn as ONE SOLID FILLED BLOCK of flat pink covering the chest and the front of the shoulders. Do NOT draw it as thin straps. Do NOT run any pink line around the belly, the ribs or the girth. NO pink may touch the legs or the paws - the pink must stop at the shoulder and never extend below the elbow
- A medium length tail carried up in a curve, tapering to a thin tip. The tail must NOT hang low.
- Lean athletic build, long legs, deep but narrow chest, tucked waist
STYLE: - Exactly three tones for the golden tan coat, two for the dark brindle stripes and saddle, one flat pink for the harness
NEGATIVE: The dog must look alert, friendly and approachable. NO bared teeth, NO snarl, NO wrinkled nose, NO raised hackles, NO lunging or pouncing pose, NO angry eyebrows. This is a guard dog shown as steady and watchful, never as threatening.
TEMPO: This is an alert athletic dog, so the swing is quick and purposeful, not slow and heavy.
TEMPO_RUN: This is an alert athletic dog with long legs, so the run is a long fast bound with plenty of extension.
EAR_TWITCH: one erect ear swivels to track a sound. Frame 1 both ears point straight up and forward. Frame 2 the near ear rotates to point outward to the side. Frame 3 the near ear rotates further back while staying erect. Frame 4 both ears point forward again. The ears stay STANDING UP the whole time - they rotate, they do not fold or droop.
MOTION_RULES:
- The dog's body stays at the SAME horizontal position and the SAME size in all frames. Only the parts described above change.
- Every paw that is on the ground must stay flat on the ground line. Paws must NOT swing up into the air in an arc.
- The legs bend at the knee and elbow. They are not stiff straight sticks rotating from the shoulder.
- All frames share the same ground line at the same height.
